questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a piecewise at a boundary
questions.stem: A biologist defines r(x)=x+2 for x<1 and r(x)=2x for x>=1, and needs r(1).
questions.explanation: Since 1 >= 1, use 2(1)=2.
questions.hint: Use the branch whose condition holds.

questions.topic: An inverse function and the restriction that makes it one
questions.learningObjective: Find an inverse value
questions.stem: A biologist restricts f(x)=x^2 to x>=0 and finds f^{-1}(25).
questions.explanation: The inverse is sqrt(x), so f^{-1}(25)=5.
